parsed.rationale: Four separate packages — Playlist, Core, Playback, and MusicShareKit — each declare an unnamed extension on URLSession in unrelated files. The Core package already contains a dedicated URLSession+WebSession.swift, which is the natural canonical home for shared URLSession behaviour. Consolidating all four extensions into Core's URLSession+WebSession.swift eliminates the name-collision risk, gives the other three packages a single import point, and avoids silent shadowing between packages that all depend on the same Foundation type. No restraint markers (is_test, is_mock, is_sample_app, is_codegen) are set on any record, so no intentional-duplication rule applies.
